column1: # One row per case, five tab-separated columns — see tests/README.md.
#   fixture   the envelope in fixtures/ the scratch repository is built from, or `-` for a
#             call refused before git is ever reached
#   args      a chain of review-round.mjs steps separated by `++`; `@round` is the id the
#             chain's `init` printed, `@file:<name>` a copy of inputs/<name> (see drive.sh)
#   exit      0 answered, 1 a submission refused, 2 called wrong, 3 could not read
#   expect    fragments of the LAST step's answer, compacted to one line, split on `|`
#   note      what the case is there to hold

column2: args
column5: note

column2: init --mode round --base base
column5: a round over committed work covers the branch's commits and names its snapshot by the head alone

column2: init --mode round --base base
column4: +wt"|"scope":"base, 2 files"|"untracked":["notes.txt"]|1 untracked path(s) are NOT reviewed
column5: uncommitted edits are part of the round and mark the snapshot, and an untracked file is named rather than silently missed

column2: init --mode round --base base
column5: standing on the base with a clean tree is said out loud, never reported as a clean review

column2: init --mode round --base nosuch
column4: nosuch is not a ref this checkout knows
column5: an unknown base is refused, never diffed against

column2: init --mode round --base no#such
column4: no#such is not a ref this checkout knows
column5: a revision is held only to never reading as an option — git, not a URL's rules, says whether it names anything

column2: init --mode pass --tree HEAD~1
column5: a pass takes any revision git reads, `HEAD~1` among them

column2: init --mode pass --tree -x
column5: a revision that would read as an option is refused before git ever sees it

column2: init --mode pass
column5: a pass reads untracked files as they stand, so one of them marks the snapshot as a tree no commit holds

column2: @write .git/index broken ++ init --mode pass
column4: git could not read the status
column5: a status git could not read is refused, never taken for a clean tree

column2: init --mode bogus
column5: a mode outside the two is a call this cannot act on

column2: init --mode pass --base base
column5: a round's flags on a pass are refused before anything is read

column2: add --round r-00000000 --source noticed
column5: an id with no round behind it is refused before git is touched

column2: add --round /tmp/hcb-review/r-1 --source noticed
column5: a path where a round id belongs is refused: a copied path is how a submission lands inside the repository

column2: INSIDE_REPO=1 init --mode round --base base
column4: TMPDIR is inside the repository under review
column5: a round kept inside the checkout would become part of the change it reviews

column2: ROUNDS_ROOT=link init --mode round --base base
column4: is not a directory of its own
column5: a rounds directory that is a link — someone else's, made first in a shared temp directory — is refused, never written through

column2: ROUNDS_ROOT=open init --mode round --base base
column5: a rounds directory anyone can write is refused: another user could plant a round in it or swap one of its files

column2: init --mode round --base base ++ add --round @round --source noticed --file @file:two.json
column5: valid candidates are stored with their anchors checked, and the task reads covered

column2: init --mode round --base base ++ add --round @round --source noticed --file @file:bad-schema.json
column5: a submission off the schema is refused whole, each error saying where, so the finder fixes and resubmits

column2: init --mode round --base base ++ add --round @round --source codex --file @file:bad-anchor.json
column4: stored:1|src/extension.ts is not in the working tree|run-warning: 1 candidate(s) anchored outside the snapshot
column5: in a round, a candidate anchored where the snapshot has nothing is dropped and named, and the source's valid ones stay

column2: init --mode round --base base ++ add --round @round --source codex --file @file:all-bad.json
column4: state:"partial"|reviewed something other than this change
column5: a source whose every anchor misses the snapshot reviewed something else, and its task is partial

column2: init --mode round --base base ++ add --round @round --source noticed --file @file:beyond.json
column4: limit.sh has 5 line(s) on the head side, and the anchor is line 99
column5: an anchor past the end of its file is outside the snapshot

column2: init --mode round --base base ++ add --round @round --source noticed --file @file:untracked-anchor.json
column5: in a round an anchor in an untracked file is outside the snapshot: init named that file as not reviewed

column2: init --mode round --base base ++ add --round @round --source noticed --file @file:two.json ++ add --round @round --source noticed --file @file:beyond.json
column5: a second submission under a task name already taken is refused, never written over the first and what it carried

column2: init --mode round --base base ++ add --round @round --source noticed --file @file:base-side.json
column5: a base-side anchor is read at the merge base, where removed code still is

column2: init --mode round --base base ++ add --round @round --source noticed
column5: nothing on stdin is refused as empty, never stored as a source that found nothing

column2: init --mode round --base base ++ add --round @round --source noticed --file @file:two.json ++ units --round @round --file @file:units-dup.json

column2: init --mode round --base base ++ add --round @round --source noticed --file @file:two.json ++ units --round @round --file @file:units-merged.json

column2: init --mode round --base base ++ add --round @round --source noticed --file @file:two.json ++ units --round @round --file @file:units-two.json ++ queue --round @round --budget x
column5: a budget that is not a number is a call this cannot act on

column2: init --mode pass ++ add --round @round --source handed --file @file:carried.json ++ units --round @round --file @file:units-one.json ++ queue --round @round

column2: init --mode pass ++ add --round @round --source handed --file @file:carried-stale.json ++ units --round @round --file @file:units-one.json ++ queue --round @round

column2: init --mode pass ++ add --round @round --source handed --file @file:carried-other-file.json ++ units --round @round --file @file:units-one.json ++ queue --round @round

column2: init --mode pass ++ add --round @round --source handed --file @file:carried-elsewhere.json ++ units --round @round --file @file:units-one.json ++ queue --round @round
column5: a carried verdict that never read the finding's own file cannot tell that file changed, a fix included, so it is checked again

column2: init --mode pass ++ add --round @round --source handed --file @file:carried-refuted.json ++ units --round @round --file @file:units-one.json ++ queue --round @round
column5: a refutation is never carried forward: it released work, and is checked again wherever it comes back

column2: init --mode pass ++ add --round @round --source handed --file @file:carried-member.json ++ units --round @round --file @file:units-plain-lead.json ++ queue --round @round
column5: only the lead's own verdict can stand for its group: another member's answered a different claim
